_comment: SET COMPLETION REWARDS: complete a set, earn its reward. Each group names the card(s) in a home set the reward is MOVED out of; the strongest by salary of the group moves into set-rewards (or wnba-set-rewards), leaves its home set, keeps its origin badge and gains the SET REWARD pill. Since 2026-09-30 a reward should beat the best card the set asks for (the user's floor rule), so most groups are one card: the set's own top card, moved out. The conference and whole-set rewards moved here from team-rewards-2026.json the same day. `id` pins a reward's id when the collision rule would otherwise rename it. Regenerate: node scripts/cardgen/generateSetRewards.js (after the home sets).

set-super-season.why: Giannis 2019-20 ($2,270), the only card in the game above the set's floor (Jokic 2021-22 + $50); it was the whole-set reward until 2026-09-30.

set-rookie.why: The set's top card moved out. Jordan's 1984-85 again since 2026-09-30 (evening): real game logs (the user: "Go for the trial, merge") dropped David Robinson's rookie card from $2,080 to $1,440, third in the set; the best left is Embiid 2016-17. Robinson was the reward from the morning's re-pick (the user: "Correct").

set-summer-standouts.why: The set's top card moved out (the user: "Correct").

set-dissonance.why: Unchanged; the id keeps the season it has carried since the 2016-17 capstone shared the set.

set-wnba-super-season.why: The set's top card moved out (the user: "Both correct").

set-wnba-rookie.why: The set's top card moved out (the user: "Both correct").

nba-conference-East.floorException: $10 under the floor (Kawhi Leonard + $50). The user: "This is fine."

nba-conference-West.floorException: $20 under the floor (Wembanyama + $50); nothing from a Western team clears. The user: "I thought the 15-16 card was like 2200 salary or something. Would make sense here."
nba-conference-West.why: His 2015-16 Super Season, moved out of the set; his 2020-21 card (the West reward until 2026-09-30) became a Throwback.

nba-set.why: Giannis 2022-23, built as a Throwback (curated-cards-2026.json) and moved in; his 2019-20 went to the Super Season set.
